content.comment_body: When attempting to install [product_name] Web Editor, I received an error: 'Most probably the bundled JVM is not compatible with the current platform.' I have tried both 32-bit and 64-bit versions, but neither works. Any advice would be appreciated!

Is your Java installation up to date? Trying both 32-bit and 64-bit versions won't help unless you match the installation to your operating system. For a 32-bit OS, use the 32-bit version; for a 64-bit OS, use the 64-bit version.
Could you clarify how I can update my Java version? I'm using Windows 8, 32-bit. Thank you.
After updating Java, I successfully installed [product_name] Web Editor. Thanks so much for your help, and apologies for my English.
This isn't a problem. What matters is that it is now functioning.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced difficulties installing [product_name] Web Editor due to a mismatch between the included JVM and their operating system. The error was unclear, leading to confusion about updating Java and choosing the correct software version compatible with their OS architecture.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipated a simple installation experience for [product_name] Web Editor, with clear instructions provided in case of errors, regardless of Java or OS compatibility issues.
